title: STPro: Spatial and Temporal Progressive Learning for Weakly Supervised Spatio-Temporal Grounding

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: STPro: Spatial and Temporal Progressive Learning for Weakly Supervised Spatio-Temporal Grounding In this work, we study Weakly Supervised Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (WSTVG), a challenging task of localizing subjects spatio-temporally in videos using only textual queries and no bounding box supervision.

problems.name: Annotation Scarcity and Noisy Supervision
problems.evidence_sentence: Recent advancements in vision-language foundation models (VFMs) [34] have shown remarkable zero-shot grounding abilities in image-based referral tasks, driven by largescale pretraining on diverse multimodal datasets [25, 29, 60].

problems.name: Domain Shift and Generalization
problems.evidence_sentence: Grounding DINO (G-DINO) [29], one of the leading VFMs, has demonstrated robust zero-shot performance on numerous imagelevel grounding benchmarks.
